lines: 第二十四章你懂的，我都懂
叶欢不咸不淡的声音响起，让一干教授都错愕的回过头。
“你说什么？简单？你竟然看不起物理？”
“太过分了，年轻人，不要以为在学校能考高分就有懂大学物理了，光是书本上那点知识，没个十几年的时间，谁也不敢说研究透了。”
一群老教授呵斥着叶欢，这个年轻人的口气明显是看不起物理。
还说不是来镀金混身份的，这人，明显什么都不懂。
刘玉权更是脸色大变，怒视着叶欢。
“数学是自然科学的基础，物理就是应用科学的基础，现代科技那一样不需要物理知识。”
他是个老教授，一辈子都扑在物理学上面了，金钱物质对他都不重要了，最讨厌的就是别人看不起物理了。
“我没说物理不重要，我只说大学所教学的物理——很简单！”
物理自然重要，即便是在宇宙之中，物理也是一切科技的基础。
宇宙战舰，超级战士……这些顶尖的科技，那一样不是建立在物理之上。
“简单？”
刘玉权表情微动，沉声道：“我研究物理学几十年了，手上用过的物理教材可以说都换过好几个版本了，也不敢说大学物理简单。”
刘玉权的语气倒是缓和了一些，听叶欢的口气，倒像是精通大学物理的学霸。
这样他倒是勉强能够接受，只是叶欢轻浮的态度他不喜欢。
“越是无知，越是狂妄，就是大学物理的考试能考满分又能怎样？你别小看了这一本小小的物理书籍，里面包含的各种推演你都理解了吗？”
“没有真正对这些公式进行理解推演，又怎么能教别人呢。”
“这些公式我没有看过，大学物理的所有书籍我都没有看过，甚至，我没有上过大学……”
“什么？你没有上过大学？”
叶欢的话还没有说完，就被刘玉权一声打断了。
“没有上过大学！大学都没有上过你还想来我们林城大学当客座教授？你做梦！”
刘玉权万万没想到，这个年轻人居然连大学都没有上过，他以为是学霸级别的毕业生！
就这种还要来大学当客座教授？
刘玉权简直震怒，拍打着桌子，“不可能！张校长，你立刻把这人带走，我绝对不同意。我林城大学虽然不是最顶尖的学府，但也是正宗985，211院校，绝对不允许被人这样侮辱！”
“对啊，校长，这也太过分了，一个大学都没有上过的年轻人，怎么可能让他成为我们物理学院的客座教授。”
“校长，我也不同意。”
一群教授也都符合起来，没有上过大学的年轻人在他们学院当客座教授？
开玩笑吧！
张校长也惊讶了，上面怎么会推荐这种人来客座教授，一个大学都没有上过的家伙。
这也太过分了！
如果说一开始张校长还想劝说各位教授的话，那么站在，他也犹豫了。
content_en:
Chapter 24 You know it, I know it too
Ye Huan's calm voice sounded, causing all the professors to turn around in surprise.
"What did you say? Simple? You actually despise physics?"
"That's too much. Young people, don't think that just because you get high scores in school, you know college physics. With just the little knowledge in books, no one can say that they have thoroughly studied it in less than ten years."
A group of old professors scolded Ye Huan. The young man's tone clearly looked down on physics.
He also said that he was not here to get gold plated to hide his identity. This person obviously didn’t understand anything.
Liu Yuquan's expression changed drastically and he glared at Ye Huan.
"Mathematics is the basis of natural science, and physics is the basis of applied science. Modern technology does not require physical knowledge."
He is an old professor who has devoted his whole life to physics. Money and materials are no longer important to him. What he hates most is that others look down on physics.
"I didn't say that physics is unimportant, I just said that the physics taught in universities is very simple!"
Physics is naturally important, even in the universe, physics is the basis of all technology.
Space battleships, super soldiers...these top technologies are not based on physics.
"Easy?"
Liu Yuquan's expression moved slightly and he said in a deep voice: "I have been studying physics for decades. It can be said that the physics textbooks I have used have gone through several versions. I dare not say that college physics is easy."
Liu Yuquan's tone softened a bit, and from Ye Huan's tone, he sounded like a top student who was proficient in university physics.
He could barely accept this, but he didn't like Ye Huan's frivolous attitude.
"The more ignorant you are, the more arrogant you are. So what if you get full marks in the college physics exam? Don't underestimate this little physics book. Do you understand all the deductions contained in it?"
“If you don’t really understand and deduce these formulas, how can you teach others.”
"I haven't read these formulas, I haven't read any college physics books, and I haven't even been to college..."
"What? You didn't go to college?"
Before Ye Huan finished speaking, he was interrupted by Liu Yuquan.
"You haven't gone to college! You haven't even gone to college and you still want to come to our Lincheng University to be a visiting professor? You're dreaming!"
Liu Yuquan never expected that this young man had never even attended college. He thought he was a top-level graduate!
Are you still going to be a visiting professor at the university?
Liu Yuquan was so furious that he slapped the table, "Impossible! Principal Zhang, take this person away immediately. I absolutely disagree. Although Lincheng University is not the top institution, it is also an authentic 985 and 211 institution. We will never allow anyone to insult you like this!"
"Yes, principal, this is too much. How can a young man who has never attended college be allowed to become a visiting professor in our School of Physics?"
"Principal, I don't agree either."
A group of professors also fit in. Young people who have never gone to college are serving as visiting professors at their college?
Just kidding!
Principal Zhang was also surprised, how could the superiors recommend such a person as a visiting professor, a guy who has never been to university.
This is too much!
If Principal Zhang wanted to persuade the professors at first, then he hesitated.
